audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Orianna's poke 'slower' and says her ball 'needs several seconds of setup'. That is the wrong read of the lane and the win rate agrees — 48.25% over 257 games, the only losing matchup in this slice.
audit.why: Command: Attack is 7/6/5/4/3s at 815 range for a flat 35 mana. By rank 5 she casts it more than twice per Pillar of Flame and pays half your mana. She wins a straight poke war; you win the single decisive rotation.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, early and dontsFull[0].d rewritten to trade on your rotation timer instead of poking back.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 line credited 'Pyroclasm's mobility' — Pyroclasm grants no mobility.
audit.why: Pyroclasm is a 750-range chain that bounces up to 5 times off Brand and nearby enemies on a 100/90/80s cooldown. Her spike is Command: Shockwave at 110/95/80s and only 410 range.
audit.corrected: mid rewritten onto the bounce count and her 410 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Command: Protect never appeared anywhere on the page, and cooldowns held no numbers at all.
audit.why: Command: Protect is a flat 9s shield at 1095 range that also grants bonus Armor and Magic Resist to whoever it attaches to — including herself — so a full rotation dumped into it buys nothing. Command: Shockwave launches you toward the ball, not toward Orianna, which is why ball position is the thing to track.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.carry rewritten around the shield and the pull.
